scope: Actual production mobile/desktop after theme settle; no content, style, response or state injection. Readonly public catalog/bank RPC only. personalVisualReview.assessment: All nine contact sheets personally viewed: actual daily title faint on light background and challenge scenario/context/active option labels near-black on dark card; learning intro dark over mixed gradient; beginner-guide statistics and link headings pale over light gradient. Dark comparisons readable. The guide share selector captured the existing Share Progress button, which is readable and is not counted as a defect. Locked disabled-module opacity excluded from automatic contrast findings. No exact gradient contrast ratio asserted.
